name: path
description: Freeform shape made of vertices with curves. The vertices are in the path's own coordinates: the path's x/y is its pivot. When creating or changing a path you can also pass "d" with an SVG path (a single subpath) and it is converted to vertices.
help: Free shape made of curved vertices, in the coordinates of the path itself (its x/y is the pivot).

vertices.help: List of vertices. Edit them with the Points tool.
vertices.description: List of vertices. See the «Vertices» section of the guide.

closed.help: Joins the last vertex to the first one.
closed.description: If true, the last vertex is joined to the first one.
